entry_points.summary: Knob description, cost-inversion caveat, NO-OP fallthrough guarantee; PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN/FLASH_PREPEND initialized unconditionally before the block
Strips cached **Complexity:** line; dispatches complexity-classifier to derive LIVE_TIER; drift-up emits tier_drift_detected and forces codex
Low-tier only; probes Flash provider; CLEAN verdict skips codex (review_gated_down); MAJORS/BLOCKERS escalates to codex with FLASH_PREPEND; provider unavailable falls through to codex
Samples low-tier tasks where Flash gated codex out; runs codex retroactively; records Flash false-negative rate — must show acceptable rate before knob is recommended
Flash pre-reviewer agent; emits **VERDICT:** CLEAN|MAJORS_FOUND|BLOCKERS_FOUND; focused on quick blockers/majors only

invariants: Z_HARNESS_IMPL_PRE_REVIEW=0 (default): entire block is NO-OP; byte-identical to today
gate-down only runs on cycle 1; retry cycles always use the full codex reviewer
Flash provider unavailable → fail-safe toward more thorough review (codex runs); never silently skip
tier-drift re-check strips cached **Complexity:** line before dispatching classifier
medium/high tier tasks are never gated down by Flash; Flash may prepend findings but is not authoritative
PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN and FLASH_PREPEND always initialized before knob block

PRE_REVIEW_GATE_DOWN (eligibility, set in P1) and PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN (skip decision, set in P2) are two DISTINCT variables — GATE_DOWN has no 'D', GATED_DOWN has 'D'; they must never be unified; downstream skip-guard reads only GATED_DOWN
gotchas: cost-inversion: Flash-on-all + codex-on-subset can exceed codex-on-all when most tasks are medium/high — run audit before enabling
complexity-classifier heuristic #1 returns cached tier if **Complexity:** present; stripping the line is mandatory
Flash verdict parsing uses grep -o 'VERDICT:[[:space:]]*[A-Z_]*'; format deviations yield empty verdict → falls through to codex (safe)
pre-reviewer is not constrained by finding threshold — codex may agree/disagree/expand when escalated with FLASH_PREPEND
Z_HARNESS_IMPL_PRE_REVIEW is env-only (not a TOML key); does not appear in config.py DEFAULTS or VALIDATORS

FOOTGUN: PRE_REVIEW_GATE_DOWN vs PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN differ by one letter ('GATE' vs 'GATED') — P1 sets GATE_DOWN=1 when eligible (no drift-up); P2 sets GATED_DOWN=1 only when Flash returns CLEAN on a low-tier eligible task; searching/editing one while intending the other is a silent bug; do NOT unify into one variable
